chunks: And from his utterances (peace be upon him) which runs like a Sermon [in which he mentions his virtues (peace be upon him), he said it after the Battle of Nahrawan]

key_terms.النَّهْرَوَانِ: Nahrawan, a location near Baghdad where the Battle of Nahrawan took place between Imam Ali and the Khawarij.
key_terms.فَضَائِلَهُ: His virtues or excellences, referring to the spiritual and moral qualities of the Imam.
key_terms.يَجْرِي مَجْرَى: Runs like or takes the place of, indicating the style or function of the text.

ai.seo_question: What is the context and content of Imam Ali's sermon delivered after the Battle of Nahrawan?
ai.summary: This header introduces a sermon by Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delivered in the aftermath of the Battle of Nahrawan, a pivotal conflict with the Khawarij that underscored his political and spiritual authority. It serves to contextualize the subsequent discourse by emphasizing his unique status and steadfastness within the early Islamic community, framing his self-description not as arrogance but as a reflection of his divinely appointed precedence.
